note: Live parity checks that are known Rust-versus-Python divergences. CI prints this list and does not fail the named script on that check. The sim is not changed to clear them. Gap 1 (contract-board board_effects) is the broker_board gamesession row and gets its own fix later. An entry whose difference stops reproducing fails the job, so this list stays exact.

entries.summary: After a Mediterranean broker is owned, arrival refreshes the contract board. GameSession passes compute_board_effects (board_quality_bonus 1.3 from the local broker). Rust Session::refresh_contract_board and the oracle refresh_board both call generate_offers with empty infrastructure effects, so the offer ids differ.

A successful prize capture agrees on fleet, crew, and cargo. The capture log row does not. Rust clear_encounter runs before blank_step, so that row's enemy id, name, strength, boarding progress, and enemy crew are empty. The oracle builds the row from the encounter first, so those fields still name the sunk band.
